answer:
I fixed it: the Habit tracker app now shows its name once at the top. The app had a fixed title above its content and drew the same title again inside it, so I removed the fixed one.

The automatic check also flagged tiny weekday letters and small tap targets. I made the weekday letters a bit larger and gave each habit's checkmark a bigger tap area. The check now passes with no issues. Your table data wasn't touched.
